form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
payment_threshold: None - full tax due by original date regardless of extension

filer: Corporations, S corps, partnerships, estates & trusts (Forms 1120, 1120-S, 1065, 1041, 1042)
form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File Certain Business Income Tax, Information, and Other Returns
length: 6 months (period varies by specific return - confirm against current Form 7004 instructions)
payment_threshold: None - full tax due by original date regardless of extension

filer: Exempt organizations & governmental entities (Form 990 series, Form 5330)
form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File an Exempt Organization Return
payment_threshold: None - any excise tax due still due by original date

form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File a Return and/or Pay U.S. Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Taxes
length: 6 months to file (automatic); payment extension discretionary under IRC 6161
payment_threshold: Payment extension requires reasonable cause shown to the IRS - not automatic

form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File Information Returns
automatic: Conditional - automatic for most covered returns; NOT automatic for Form W-2

filer: U.S. citizens/residents with tax home and abode outside the US and Puerto Rico
form: None required (automatic); Form 2350 for FEIE qualification extension
form_name: Automatic 2-month extension for taxpayers abroad; Form 2350 for additional time to qualify for the foreign earned income exclusion
length: 2 months automatic (to June 15); Form 2350 extends further for FEIE qualification only
payment_threshold: None required to obtain the extension, but interest accrues on unpaid tax from April 15

form_name: Automatic extension - no application form; use FTB 3519 only to submit a payment
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026, for the 2025 tax year)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original April 15 date regardless of extension; use FTB 3519 to pay by mail

filer: Corporations, S corps, exempt organizations, LLCs, partnerships (Forms 100, 100S, 100W, 199, 565, 568)
form: None required (automatic); payment vouchers FTB 3539 (corps/exempt orgs), FTB 3537 (LLCs), FTB 3538 (partnerships/REMICs)
form_name: Automatic extension - no application required; payment voucher only if tax is owed
length: 7 months for corporations/exempt organizations (Form 100/100W/199); 6 months for S corporations (Form 100S), partnerships, and LLCs
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original due date regardless of extension

form_name: Application for Automatic Six-Month Extension of Time to File for Individuals
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026, for the 2025 tax year)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original due date; the extension request itself must be filed by the original due date to be valid

form_name: Request for Six-Month Extension to File (franchise/business tax return)
payment_threshold: Properly estimated tax must be paid with the extension request to avoid penalty

tax_type: Franchise tax (no individual income tax in Texas)
filer: Taxable entities filing the Texas Franchise Tax Report
length: To August 17, 2026 (first extension); to November 16, 2026 for entities required to pay by electronic funds transfer (EFT) that make a second extension payment
payment_threshold: Must pay 100% of the tax due for the prior year, or 90% of the tax that will be due for the current year, with the extension request

tax_type: Corporate income tax (no individual income tax in Florida)
form_name: Florida Tentative Income/Franchise Tax Return and Application for Extension of Time to File Return
length: 6 months (7 months for June 30 fiscal-year filers with tax years beginning before January 1, 2026)
payment_threshold: Must pay 100% of the tentatively determined tax due with F-7004; the extension is void if the underpayment exceeds the greater of $2,000 or 30% of the tax shown on the return when filed (Fla. Stat. §220.32)

form: None required (automatic); Form IL-505-I only to submit a payment
length: 6 months (to October 15, 2026, for the 2025 tax year); an Illinois extension longer than 6 months is allowed to match a federal extension that exceeds 6 months
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original April 15 date regardless of extension

form: None required (automatic); Form IL-505-B only to submit a payment
form_name: Automatic Extension Payment for Corporations, Partnerships, and Fiduciaries
length: 7 months (8 months for June 30 fiscal-year corporations)
payment_threshold: None to obtain the extension, but full tax is due by the original due date regardless of extension
